title: Machi Koro-style microphone category icon spec
purpose: Small circular category badge placed immediately before the Karaoke Club card title.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the icon asset; it will be composited before the title by the card-rendering script.
integration_context.background: Native RGBA transparency is mandatory outside the circular badge. Do not draw or bake any backdrop into RGB.
integration_context.output_preference: RGBA PNG with alpha=0 outside the circular badge and clean antialiased alpha edges
integration_context.composition: one centered circular badge filling most of the square canvas

icon_color.description: Fill color of the circular badge, matching the dark red card footer.

subject.description: A simple white microphone silhouette tilted slightly upward.

pictogram.subject: handheld karaoke microphone
pictogram.description: One chunky white microphone silhouette with a rounded grille and short handle, tilted gently upward from lower left to upper right; no cable, notes, stars, letters, or extra objects.
pictogram.shape_language: very simple, chunky, geometric, slightly rounded, icon-like
pictogram.line_rule: Solid white silhouette with two or three thick negative-space grille slots at most; avoid thin line art.

visual_style.core: Flat two-color Machi Koro category badge.
visual_style.colors: dark red #58100E circle plus pure white pictogram
visual_style.small_size_priority: must remain instantly recognizable beside a card title

anti_patterns: do not omit the round badge
do not add a white outer ring
do not use gradients, highlights, bevels, texture, or shadows
do not add text, musical notes, stars, a cable, a hand, card furniture, or scenery
do not output an opaque background or a checkerboard
do not make the symbol detailed or thin

current_icon.subject: handheld karaoke microphone
current_icon.expected_result: A dark-red circular badge with a centered bold white microphone silhouette and transparent pixels outside the circle.

final_prompt_summary: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: tiny title-row category icon for a Machi Koro-style card. Generate one perfect solid dark-red circle in exact color #58100E, centered and filling about 85% of a square canvas. Inside it, precisely center a bold simple white handheld karaoke microphone silhouette, tilted slightly upward from lower left to upper right, filling about 54% of the circle. Use a rounded grille and short chunky handle; at most two or three thick negative-space grille slots. Native RGBA transparency is mandatory outside the circle, with clean antialiased edges. Flat two-color vector-style artwork only. No border, text, letters, musical notes, cable, hand, stars, shading, gradient, texture, 3D effect, shadow, glow, backdrop, checkerboard, or card furniture.
